tei:div.tei:p: (277)sdom gsum gyi nyams len snying po dril pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ (278)sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs kyi pad+mor sgo gsum gus pas rtag tu phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o byi gyis brlabs tu gsol dom phrug khos bslab pa'i gnas bsung bya rags rim zhig blo theg nas 'jag pa zhig bri dgos/ sdom gsu rnam par ngos pa'i don rnams bo mkhos kyi bsdu mi thub ces bskul ba don yod par bya ba'i pyir 'di ni bslab pa'i rkang grangs rags rim zhig smras pa 'di rnams blo la blangs nas dus rtag tu sdom pa gsum gyi gnas rnams dran shes bzhin bag yod gsum gyi skya bar bsrung*/ dgos ma gtogs/ deng sang nyams lon zhig mgo khur (279)byas nas bslab pa'i rkang grangs mi shes zhing*/ srung bya srung byed mod rig pa gcig su 'dis thams cad kyi go chod zer nas smyon pa 'ur langs pa lta bur mi byed dgu byed cig byas/ nga sngags pa dang bsgom chen yin zer ba 'di tsho/ sangs rgyas kyis bstan pa'i chom rkun pa chen po du ru ka stong las thu ba zhig deng sang dar 'dug pas/ de 'dra'i lad mo mi byed par bslab pa rnams tshul bzhin du bsrung dgos pas na/ dang po thar ba'i dge bsenan gyi skabs nas/ dang po sadom pa len du bsam pa'i kyad par gyi sna gcig sna 'ga' sogs dbye ba yod na'ang*/ deng sang dge bsnyen kyi sdom pa lan de 'dra'i dbye ba bla slob gnyis kas mi shes zhing*/ spyi btang tsam re sbyin len gyi srol yod pas/ de lta na/ rtsa ba (280)bzhi ni srog bcod pa dang*/ ma byin par len pa dang*/ 'dod pa'i log par g.yom pa dang*/ rdzun du smra ba dang bzhi'o/ 'di dag gi yul gyi+u na lag du mi yin pa go dgos so/ de dag gi+u lag du chang spang dgos de ma spang na bslab pa gzhan rnams bsrung mi nus pa'i phyir/ rtsa ba bzhi dang chang dang lnga spang dgos/

de'i steng sngags kyi sdom pa thob na khyim pa'i dge bsnyen gyis/ rab tu byung ba'i rtags ngur smig gi chos gos bsgo ba/ lhung bzed 'chag ba sogs rab byung gi rtags kyi skor dang*/ lus kyi che ga dang bcas rkyang 'ba' zhig ma gtogs 'dul ba nas ji ltar gsungasha pa bzhin nyams su len dgos par dpung bzag gi rgyud las bdag cag gi ston pa thugs rje can de'i gsungs la/ ba ngas gsung so sor thar ba yi/ tshul khrims rnam dag 'dul ba ma lus las/ sngags pa khyim pas rtags dang cha lugs spang*/ lhag ma rnams ni mas su blang bar bya/ zhes gsungs pa'i (281)phyir/ rab tu byung bas sngags sdom thob na rtags dang cha lugs 'chang dgos par ma zad nyes byas tshun chod nas 'dul ba ji lta ba bzhin nyams su len dgos pa smros ci dgos pa snga ma'i lung de'i phyir/ ༈ gnyis pa rab byung gi phyogs kyi bslab pa la/ bde 'dir dge slob ma dang dge slong ma gnyis kyi sdom pa sbyin pa'i phyag srol ma byung bas/ dge tshul gyi bslab pa la/ rags pa bcu dang zhib mo sum cu yod pa las/ 'phags pa kun dag 'debs bri je'i bu la bslab pa mdor bsdus te bstan pa la/ rtsa ba bzhi dang*/ ུna lag drug las/ dang po ni/ mi'am mir chags pa srog gcod pa dang gcig rin thang tshang ba'i dngos po rku ba dang gnyis/ mi tshangs bar spyod pa dang gsum/ mi chos bla ma'i rdzun smra ba dang bzhi'o/ 'di rnams la gzhi bsam pa sbyor ba mthar thug bzhi tshang na pham 'dra dang*/ ma tshang na 'chab med gser rung ba tsam yin/ bshags bya'i nyos byas la drug las/ myos 'gyur gyi chang (282)'thung ba dang gcig rgod bag gis rang dgar/ gru gar rtse ba rol mo 'khrol ba ste gar sogs gsum dang gnyis/ 'phyor sgog gis bsam pas/ rgyan phreng 'dogs pa kha dog 'chang ba/ dri zhim par spos byug pa ste 'phreng sogs gsum dang gsum/ rgyu rin thang can dang khru gang las lhag pa'i mal che mtho 'dug pa spang ba dang bzhi/

phyi dri dus rung gi zas la spyod pa dang lnga*/ gser dngul lon pa spong na dang drug go/ 'di bcu srung na dge tshul mtshan nyid pa yin/ zhib mo sum cu rtsa ba bzhi dang de'i char gtags kyi nes byas kyi dbe ba yin te/ sdom ni/ rtsa bzhi gsod gsum gzhi med nas/ sun 'byi bar lnga shes bzhi bshes/ 'phya dang zas dang lhag lib skur/ nyes 'jog 'bras chana'agegs dang chang*/ gar gsum phreng gsu mal che mtho/ dus min rin chen bar ma gsum/ de ltar sum cu rtsa gsum mo/ zhes pham 'dra'i srog gcod kyi char gtogs dud 'gro gsod pa/ srog chags dang bcas pa'i rtsa chur 'debs/ srog chags (283)dang bcas pa'i chu la longs spyod pa/ rdzun gyi char gtogs/ gzi med dang bag tsam gyi dge slong la pham pa'i skur 'debs/ dge 'dun dbyen/ de'i rjes pyogs khyim pa sun 'byi gyi las/ shes bzhin du rdzun smra ba/ bshes ngor 'phya ba/ zhal ta ba 'phya/ zas cung zad kyi phyir chos ston zhes dge slong la skur 'debs dang*/ lhag ma'i skur 'debs dang*/ bslab pa khyad dasod kyi spong ba'o/ lhag po len phyir 'bras chan tshod mas 'gebs pa ste/ rtsa ba bzhi dang bcu dgu/ de'i stong du/ chang gar sogs gsum/ phreng sogs gsum/ mal che mtho rnams so sor brtsis/ phyi dro'i kha zas/ gser dngul lon pa bsnan pa gsum bcu dang*/ khyad par du gyur pa bsam ma thag pas khyim pa'i gos sbu gu can nyin gcig tsam 'chang na/ khyim pa'i rtags spong ba las nyams/ rab tu byung ba'i rtags blangs ba las nyams/ mkhan po mkhan por gsol ba btab pa las nams pa yin pas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rtags (284)kyi che ba ngur smig gi rgyal mtshan 'chang ba shin tu gal che ba dang phan yon yang bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ rgyal tshab rjes/ srid gsum bdag po sngar yang lan brgyar byas/ ngur smirag rgyal mtshan 'chab da ris tsam/ zhes dang*/ dus 'khor las/ ngur smig 'dzin pa mthong gyur na/

lha min lha yi tshor ma dag sa yi 'og tu 'bros par 'gyur/ zhes/ bdag cag gi ston pas/ rgyal po gzugs can snying po'i ngor gos ngur smig gi rgyal mtshan gnang ba dang*/ bslab pa'i gzhi dang po gos bo ba nas bca' ba mdzad pas/ gos sne tshang rgyu bzang ngan la mgo ltos kyang*/ dmar po'i kha dog can nag po sakaya bo min pa mdog legs po res/ gzan shams sne tshag ba re 'chang dgos/ slag rgan re gyon nang na sgom zer ba'i chen po re yod mdog gis rag gi rang mgo rang gi bskor/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i bla btsong yin pas e shes bu lo lo/ da dge slong gi bslab pa la sade lnga las/ ston pas rab byung gi rten la (285)bcas pa'i bslab pa lasa'adas pa'i lus ngag gi las ni ltung ba'i ngo bo ste/ spong bdun gyi rang bzhin tshul khrims kyi mi mthun phyogs su gyur pa'i ltung ba yin pa'i phyir/ 'di la dngos po gtso bo gyur pa dang*/ 'du shais gtso bor gyur ba gnyis las/ dang po mi tshangs spyod lta bu dang*/ pyi ma rdzun smra'i ltung ba lta bu'o/ dbye ba la/ dge slong gi ltung ba sde lnga las/ pham lhag bcu bdun po legs par bsrung na/ dge slong mtshan nyid dang ldan par rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling bas zhal bzhes gnang bas de ltar na/ dang po rtsa ba bzhi las/ gzhi bsam pa sbyor ba mthar thug tshang ba'i mi tshangs spyod pa dang gcig gnyis pa ma byin len pa'i pham pa ni/ gzhi bsam pa sbyor ba mthar thug tshang ba'i sgo nas gzhan gyi nor rin thang tshang ba'i dngos po dus gcig la brkus pa'o/ rin thang tshang ba ni/ kā ri ka lnga bcu pa las/ kar+sha pa ṇi'i bzhi cha brkus/ de bskus tshul khrims zhig par gyur/ zhes rgya gar rgyal rma bya ba'i dus na(236)gser skra ma slang yi dong tshe de'i bzi cha gser skra ma gang dang bzhi cha dngul ṭaṃ1 dang skra ma phyed dang gsu gyi rin thang tshang ba'o/ gsam pa srog gcod kyi pham pa ni/ gzhi bsam pa sbyor ba mthar thug tshang bar mi'am mir chags pa'i srog gcod pa'o/

bzhi pa rdzun smra'i pham pa ni/ gzi bsam sbyor ba mthar thug tshang bar bsam pa bden pala'i 'du shes bsgyur nas rdzun brjod 'dod kyi sgo nas/ mngon shes la sogs pa gzhan las khyad par du gyur ba'i yon tan gyi tshogs med kyang yod ces mi'i chos las bla ma'i gong ma'i rdzun smras pa'o/ gnyis pa lhag ma'i sde la/ nang sems can la chags pa lnga dang*/ pyi+o yad byad la chags pa gnyis ste/ 'dod chags las gyur pa bdun/ gnod pa las gyur pa gnyis/ bsgo ba las gyur pa bzi ste bcu gsum yod pa'i/ dang po 'byin pa'i lhag ma ni/ 'grod pa'i yul lam gsum ma yin par/ rang ngam gzhan gh+yi lan lag gi gnas su khu ba byung 'dod pas nor bu reg cing rtsol ba las khu ba gnas nas 'phos shing bde ba nyams (287)su myong ba'o/ gnyis pa 'dzin pa'i lha ma ni/ yul bud med 'khrig pa brten tung gi lus kyi cha shas la chags sems kyis rjen par reg pa'i bde ba nyams su myong/ gsum pa 'khrig tshig rjen smrī ni/ yul brda 'phrod pa'i bu med la chags sems kyis yul dus der grags pa'i 'khrig tshig rjen par smras nas yul de'i ga bo'o/ bzhi ba bsnyen bkur gyi bsngags pa'i lhag ma ni/ yul bud med la chags sems kyis/ bdag lta bu'i dge slong la 'khrig pas bsnen bkur byas na bsnyen bkur thams cad kyi nang nas mchog go zhes smras nas/ yul des bo ba'o/ lnga pa smyan byed ni/ rang las gzhan pa'i khyim pa pho mo sprad tung ba phan tshun sbyor 'dod kyis de gnyis kyi phrin lan gsum gyis bskyal nas/ de gnis 'dus te dbang po 'phrad pa na dge slong la ltung ba'o/ drug pa khang pa'i lhag ma ni/ gzhi srog chags mang zhing*/ rtsed pa can dang 'jigs rkyen yod pas mi rug ba'i gzhir gzhan la yod byad bslang nas dge 'dun gyis gnang ba ma thob par/ rag don du khang pa srid du (288)khru bco brgyad dang*/ zhing du khru phyed dang bcu gcig gi tshad las lhag pa brtsigs nas thog phub zin pa na ltung ba'o/

bdun pa khang pa che ba brtsigs pa'i lhag ma ni/ gzhan gang zag bzhi la sogs pu na chad kyi dge 'dun gyi don du tshad lhagu na lag tu mi dgos kyang*/ gzhan thams cad sngar dang 'dra bar brtsigs nas thog long ba na ltung ba'o/ brgyad pa gzhi med kyi skur 'debs kyi lhag ma ni/ mthong thos degs gsum gyi gzhi med pa'i dge slong la me tshangs spyod kyi pham pa'i bskur ba btab pa'o/ dgu ba gag tsam gyis kur 'debs kyi lhag ma ni/ ུla dge slong la bud med dang gtam smra ba tsam gyis skad ka bag tsam la brten nas tshig gi shugs kyis mi tshangs spyod kyi pham pa'i skur ba btab pa'o/ bcu ba dge bdun 'byon gyi lhag ma ni/bcas ldan dge slong rang ma ི the ba'i dbyen bya dge 'dun du long gnyisu na chad chos min gyi lta bas phan tshun 'byed par byed pa'o/ bcu ba dge 'dun dbyen gyi lhag ma ni/ bcas ldan dge slong rang mi tho ba'i dbyen bya dge 'dun du long gnyisu na chad chos min gyi lta bas phan tshun 'byed par byed pa'o/ bcu gcig pa byon de'i rjes phyogs kyi lhag ma ni/ snga ma dbyen byed pa dge slong de'i grogs byed 'dod kyi rjes su rgyug (289)pa'o/ deng sang skur 'debs gnyis dang dbyen gnyis kyi lhag ma gnyis kyi rjes su sgrub pa'i dge slong shin tu mang bas dus rgyun du kha 'di la brtags dpyad zhib du dgos/ bcu gnyis pa khyim pa sun 'byin gyi lhag ma ni/ yul bud med dang lhan cig tu rtse 'jo dang bza' btung snod gcig tu byed pa bslab pa dang 'gal ba'i ngan spyod kyis khyim pa'i sems sun 'byihan nas ma dad par byed pa'o/ bcu gsum pa bka' blo mi bde ba'i lhag ma ni/ dge slong la lhag pa'i tshul khrims kyi dbang du byas te/ ltung ba byung ba gang yang rung ba phyir bcos par bskul te glong ba na/ brjod pa ma rnyed nas rtsed pa'i gzhir zhugs te bka' blo mi bde ba 'khrugs pa'i gzhir zhugs pa'o/

༈ spang ltung sum cu'i skabs kyi zhib tu gzhung la ltos/ gtso bo chos gos gsum dang gdong ba dras shing drub pa byin gyis brlab pa 'bral med du 'chang*/ lhung bzed rung ba tshad dang ldan pa re 'chang*/ phyi dro'i kha zas spang te gung tshig re gyis/ gos bsgo tshulu na chad shin tu legs pa re ci nas gyis dang de tsam la so thar gyi bslab pa rnams tshang gi (290)'dug 'di rnams phyi tshul 'chos logs po re kyis dang*/ tshul 'chos rgas pa tshul khrims zer ba'i dpe lus ngag gi steng 'di na las rgyu zhig yod/ nang sems kyi mno bsam tsam la de tsam gtso bar gsungs med pas gza' rgyu zhig los yod/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa rnams phyi lus ngag la mi ltos par nang sems kyi 'du shes bzang ngan la rag las pas cung zad bsrung dka'/ gsang sngags kyi sdom pa thams cad ye shes kyi stong nasartsi bas shin tu bsrung dka' na yang sdom pa gsum po blang tshar bas/ da byang chub sems dpa'i b.lasab pa la/ nyon sprod sdom pa/ dge ba chos sdud/ sems can don byed gsu las/ dang po 'di med na phyi ma gnyis la re ba med pas/ dang po la lugs gnyis kyis kyis zab mo lta ba'i srol gyis rtsa ltung bco brgyad/ smon 'jug gi bslab bya gnyis dang nyi shu yod pas/ dang po la/ ming du rtsa ltung bco brgyad la/ rdzas kyi bcu bzhir gsungs pa'i/ dang po byang chub sems dpa'i rgyal po la 'byung nyo ba lnga ni/ dkon mchog gyi dkor 'phrog pa gcig dam pa'i chos yang dag pa theg pa (291)gsum gya lung dang rtogs pa'i chos rnams ston pas bka' dang thar ba thob pa'i thabs ma yin no zhes spang ba gnyis pa'o/ bslab pa bzung yang tung ma bzung yang rung*/ rab tu byung ba'i cha lugs 'dzin pa dag la chad pa gcod gsum pa'o/ pha ma gnyis dgra bcom pa bsad pa/ dge bdun gyi dbyen byed pa/ sangs rgyas la ngan sems kyi khrag 'byin pa ste mtshams med pa'i las snga gang tung byed pa bzhi ba'o/

lnga ba ni/ las rgyu 'bras med ces log par lta ba 'dzin pa'o/ blon po la 'byung nye ba lnga ni/ rgyal pos snga ma bzhi'i steg du log lta dor ba'i bzhi'i stong du/ grong khyim gcig pa dang*/ jong mi rigs bzhi gnas pa/ grong khyer bzo sna bco brgyad yod pa/ grong brdal ni phyogs kyi tshong pa mang po 'du sa/ yul 'khor ni tsam pa ka lta bu'i yul chen po rnams zhe sdang gis khang me ro dud spurd nas brlag pa'o/ ci'i phyir na rgyal po skyid bde bar gnas pas log lta 'byung nye la/ blon po na rgyil po'i bya ba'i don gyis phyogs gang du'ang rgyu ba'i skyid sdug (292)dang bzang ngan mang po mthong bas rgyu 'bras med lta 'byung dka' bas/ grong sogs brlag pa rnams bzhag go/ dam pa phal bal 'byung nye ba brgyad ni/ blo ma sbyangs pa la stong pa nyid ston pa dang gcig theg chen gyi rigs can theg dman du sems bcug pa rdzogs byang las phyir log par byed pa dang gnyis/ nyan thos kyi rigs nges la so sor thar ba spang nas theg chen du slob du bcug pa gsum po/ nyan thos kyi lam la 'bras bu med par 'dzin du bcug na bzhi ba'o/ phrag dog gis bsam pas bdag la bstod cing byang chub sems dpa' gzhan la smod na lnga ba'o/ bsnyen bkur gyi phyir ma rtogs bzhin du bdag gis chos zab mo stong pa nyid rtogs go zhes rang nyid 'tshong ba'i rdun smras na drug pa'o/ dge slong gi rdas dbang po che gzhan la thabs kyis sbyin pa dbyed na dge sbyong la noragyis chad pa gcod du 'jug na bdun pa'o/ spong ba bsam gtan pa'i longs spyod klog pa bsam pa la byin na brgyad pa'o/ de dag 'byung ne dbang gis bzhag gi las dang po ba'i skabs na thams cad po bsrung dgos so/ de dag gi steng (293)du smon 'jug gi sems gnyis spang na ltung bar 'gyur bas/ smon sems gtong ba la/ sems can blos btang dang rnam mkhyen blos btang gnyis kya gtong la/

de btang bas rten kyang log pas brten pa ri mi 'jig pa bzhin yin pas do gnyis mi nyams par bsrung dgos la/ bslab btus su bslab pa mdor bsdus te gsungs pa 'di shin tu gal che bas/ rgyal po la gdams pa'i mdo las/ rgyal po chen po khyod ni 'di ltar bya ba mang ba/ byed pa mang ba ste/ thams cad kyis thams cad du sbyin pa nas shes rab pha rol du phyin pa'i bar la bslab par mi nus kyis/ de bas na rgyal po chen po khyod/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la 'dun pa dang*/ dad pa dag*/ don du gnyer ba'i smon pa gsu 'gro yag tung*/ 'dug kyang rung*/ nyal yang rung*/ sad kyang rung*/ za yang rung*/ btung yang rung*/ rtag par rgyun du dran pas yid la bzung ste bsgom shig gzhan gyi dge ba la rjes su yi rang bar gyis shig rjes su yi rag nas kyang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas la (294)phul cig phul nas kyang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du gyis shig de nas sems can thams cad kyi sangs rgyas kyi chos yongs su rdogs par 'gyur bar nyi gcig bzhin du bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bsngos shig rgyal po chen po de lta ba rgyal srid kyang byed la/ rgyal po'i bya ba yang nyams par mi 'gyur la/ byang chub kyi tshogs kyang yongs su rdogs par 'gyur ro/ zhes b.lasab pa thams cad bsdus te rin chen byang chub kyi sems sbyang ba la nyin mtshan med par brtson pa la 'dus par bstan pas byang chub sems la slob sbyang ba 'di gal che bas yid la 'jag pa gyis sabom yor du bla ma ga ge mo cig zer/ che ge 'di zer bya bas sems la 'byor dus mi 'ong bar nyams len 'di 'dra zhig gyis dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dngos ma red kyang*/ lam sne zhig zin nas 'ong ngo*/ thog med srol la/ kun slong ser sna/ 'dod chags/ khong khro/ gti mug bzhis sbyor ba chos dang nor mi ster ba gnyis/

bdag bstod gzhan la smod pa gnyis/ brdeg 'tshong dang shad sbyang mi len (295)gnyis yang dag pa'i chos spang zhig*/ chos ma hayin pa ston pa gnis dag brgyad po yin pas srol gnyis gang rung ro srung sdom pa gnyis ka thob tshar bas bslab pa mi bsrung ba'i sems yar khas len na ngo mi tsha'am/ da dung nga byang chub sems dpa' yin zer nas mig skra ma log log byed nas nag po'i chos bzhi la chu 'bog 'bog byed mkhan mang po mthong bas tshe rabs thams cad du byang chub gyi sems mi brjod cing mi nyams zhing dran pa'i thabs su nag po'i chos bzhi spang zhing dkar po'i chos bzhi blang dgos pas/ de rnams ni/ dkon mchog gcegs pa'i 'do srung gis zhus pa'i le 'ur/ 'od srung chos bzhi dang ldan na byang chub kyi sems brjod par 'gyur te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ mchod par 'os pa bsru ba dang*/ gzhan 'gyod 'i gnas ma yin pa la 'gyod pa bskyed pa dang*/ sems bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la sdang sems kyi skyon nas brjod pa dang*/ sems can la g.yo dang sagayus spyaud pa'o/ zhes so/ de la ldog pa ni dkar po'i chos bzhi yin pas(296)sgrub par byas te/ de nyid las 'od srung chos bzhi dang ldan na byang chub kyi sem sabarjod par mi 'gyur te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ shes bzhin du rdzun mi smra ba dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' la ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed pa dang*/ sems can la g.yo sgyu med par lhag mapa'i bsam pa'i gnas pa dang*/ sems can thams cad theg pa chen po la yang dag par 'god pa'o/ zhes gsungs pa rnams bslab btus su rgyal po la gdams pa'i mdor bstan pa'i byang chub sems nyag ma gcig su bsgom pa la ma 'dus pa med kyang 'di rnams la blang dor tshul bzin byed na byang chub sems dpa' ming ma btags kyang ral la 'di phyir phan pa'i rgyun lags pas med la nges pa dgos/ gong 'og gi sdom pa gsum gyi bslab bya sna re re nas byang chub sems kyis zin pa zhig shin tu gal che/

dge ba phra mo gas tshags legs par bcad dus dang*/ gud tshig byed dus na bsam pa bzang po byang chub kyi sems 'di dang po nas i dran mi ltos la gzob dang*/ nam zhig dge ba gang bsgrub thams cad kyi sna la semasade rag bzhin ngang gis 'bung dus zhig kho bo'i (297)myong bas grub pa zhig yin pas gal che/ de ltar na gung tshig gi lto khams re zos pa na byang chub gyi sems re res zin pa byas nas zas kyi lto 'grang ba nas dge bcas blo bde 'bol gyi 'ong ba zhig dgos so/ ༈ da ni gsang sngags kyi sdom pa la/ brtul zhugs nyer lnga rigs lnga phyi nang rtsa ltung bcu bzhi sbom po brgyad rnams ni gsar snying spyi la grags pa'i gtso bo gsar phyogs kyi dam tshig gi dbye ba yin pas/ 'dir ni sga 'gyur ba rang gi thun mongs ma yin pa'i dam tshig nges par bsrung dgos ngo shes pa mdo sgyu sems gsum gyi/ sgyu 'phrul drwa ba las/ bla med mi spag bla ma bkur/ sngags dang phyag rgya rgyun mi bcad/ yang dag lam du zhugs la byams/ gsang ba'i don phyir smra mi bya/ 'di ni rtsa ba lnga rnams ste/ sgrub dang srung ba'i dam tshig mchog zhes rtsa ba lnga dngu na lag bcur bstan pa'i rtsa ba lnga legs par srung na dam ldan gyi rnal 'byor pa yin pas/ dang po ble da mi spang ba ni/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sem sadag*/ don dam par spros pa (298)ne bar zhi ba'i byang chub kyi sems gnyis/ the tshom dang log ltas mi spang bar rgyun du lta sgom spyod gsum gyi nyams su len pa'o/ gnyis pa bla ma bkur ba ni/ spyir yul drug gsungs kyang*/ zhi ba lha rgyud las/ rgyud bkrol dbang bskur de nyid bstan/ bla ma nyid dang lhan cig grogs/ lus ngag yid kyi bkur ba ni/ rdo rje sku yi dam tshig go/ zhes/ rag la sngags kyi dbang bskur rgyud 'chad man ngag ston pa'i slob dpon gsu sangs rgyas las lhag par dkon mchog bzhi bar bltas te/

sgo gsu g.yo zol med pa'i thugs ci mnyos dang ci gsung gi dka' sgrub pa'i sgo nas bkur bar bya'o/ gsum pa sngags dang phyag rgya rgyun mi bcad pa ni/ rang gi dam lha yi sngags gsum phyag rgya bzhi rab rgyun du'am/ 'bring nya stong dus drug gam tha na lo zlar ma chags par brtson pa'o/ bzhi pa mched la byams pa bya ba ni/ spyi ring nye ba 'dres pa'i mched bzhi las/ spyir theg pa chen po la zhugs pa khyad par bla ma lha dang dkyil 'khor gcig gis bsdus pa'i dam tshig dang ldan pa'i (299)mched la byams par byed pa'o/ lnga ba gsang don mi smra ba ni/ spyir dang bar gsang bzhi bzhi dang*/ 'os dang gnyer gtad rnam pa bcu/ zhes pas/ spyi gsang bzhi ni/ gsal bkra las/ lta zab spyod pa rlangs po dang*/ lha ming gzungs dang grub rtags rnams/ spyi gsang rnam pa bzhi yin no/ zhes lta ba zag mo lhag pa don dam bden pa lhag pa kun rdzob bden pa lhag pa dbyer med chen po/ blo dman the tshom can dang*/ spyod pa la gsar du zhugs pa dang log lta can rnams la gsang ba'o/ yi dam lha'i mtshan dang de'i sngags dang*/ de 'grub ba'i rtags rnams nang la 'dres pa la bshad na dam tshig nyams shing*/ 'dres pa la rang dgar bstan na dngos grub nyams par gsung pas dus thams cad du kha yang mi byed par gsang dgos rgyu yin pa la/ dus phyis mtho dman thams cad nas/ ngas lha bsnyen grub rtags 'di byung zhes rang 'tshong ngo tsha mad lapa'i gtam sgrogs pa 'di rigs la bag yod dgos/ bar gsang bzhi ni/ gsal bkra las/ sgrub pa'i gnas dus grogs dang rjes/ bar du gsang la sgrub par bya/ zhes pas (300)gang dang sgrub pa'i gnas dang*/ 'du ba'i dus dang*/ sgrub pa'i grogs dang*/ rdzas dang bzhi tshogs sgrub pa'am gsang ba'i spyod pa la zhugs pa de srid rdzogs bar du gsang ba'o/ gsang bar 'os pa ni/ thun mong ma yin pa sngags kyi spyod pa khyad par ba rnams dang dam rdzas mched lcam gyi ngan spyod sogs gzhan gyis mthong thos sogs mi rung ba rnams gsang ba'o/

gsang bar gnen gtad ni/ bla ma dang mched lcam gyis 'di ni gzhan la brjod par mi bya'o/ zhes gsang rgyas btab pa gsang ba'o/ zhi ba lhas rgyud las gzhan yang slob dpon mched lcam gyis/ gsang bar bsgrags nas gnas skabs su/ de ltar 'os sa shin tu gsang*/ zhes so/ de ltar rtsa ba'i dam tshig lnga las bla med mi spang ba dang sngags dang phyag rgya rgyun mi gcod pa ni yon tan khyad par can sgrub pa'i dam tshig yin la/ gzhan gsum po ni de'i grogs su 'gyur ba'i phyir srung ba'i dam tshig yin te/ sgrub dang srung ba'i dam tshig mchog ces gsung ba'i phyir/ rtsa ba lnga po 'di gtan ma nyams pa'i kyang nyos ltung dang zhag tu ma 'grogs pa zhig (301)ngos par dgos/ mdor na dran shes gnyis ra mda' rgyug rgyug byed nas rang rgyud dag ngos bar re byed na rang gi rang la che'o mo phrug nag ris/ ུna lag gi dam tshig bcu las/ dang po lnga ni/ rgyud las/ gti mug chags dang zhe sdang dang*/ nga rgyal phrag dog mi spong ngo*/ zhes 'di la rang bzin spongs shes kyi mi spongs te/ nyon mongs pa rang bzhin med par rtogs na rnams par grol ba yin pa dang*/ thabs kyis zin na mi spong ba'i tshul gnyis gsungs kyang las dad po bas de 'dra 'ong rgyu dka' mo red/ nyon mongs la gnyen po la brten gyin sdod/ sa nyis sa dang blang lnga ni/ rgyud las/ dkar rtsi dmar rtsi dri sha chen/ dag pa'i snod bcud mi dor re/ ུna lag bcu yi dam mchog ye nas dag mnyam rtogs pas spyad/ zhes gsungs bas/ mnyam bzhag gi ngo kha na dag mnyam chen por rtogs pa dang*/ rjes theg kyi rol ba rigs lnga'i rang bzhin du shes nas gong ma khyad par can gyi sgrub pa'i sman sgrub kyi zegs ma re la dus bzang re longs spyod na des chog go/ de ma yin par kha bshad tsam (302)gyis/ chos nyid kyis grub pa/ rang gi ngo bos grub pa/ nus pa mthu yis grub pa/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i grub pa sogs yin yin bden bden mang pos rag mgo rang gis g.yog nas sha lnga bdud lnga la dngos su spyod mdog 'di smyon pa glabs rdol ba dang khyad par med do/

spyi mdo las/ sku dang gsung thugs rdo rje yis/ bsrung dang spyad dang yid 'ong dang*/ mi mdor shes bya sgrub pa dang*/ zhes nyi shu rtsa brgyad grangs nges can du bstan pa/ ma hā yo ga'i rtsa ba dngu na lag gi dam tshig de dag du nges par 'dus pas/ de ltar na srung ba'i yul lha dang bla ma gnyis su med pa gtso bor smros pa'i mched lcam dang bcas la/ lus kyi rnam 'gyur gyis bkur/ ngag gis bstod yid kyis gus par bya/ ngag gis phan pa'i tshig kha don dang bzlas brjod zab mo byed/ srog dang rtsol ba la goms par byed/ yid smon 'jug gis sems gnyis bskyed/ ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab sgrub zhes bye ba mang po zhig gsungs nas/ mdor na sku'i dam tshig du bla ma dang lha la gus par blta zhing mched dang lcam dral gyis mtshon pa'i 'gro ba thams (303)cad bla ma'i sku'i gdul bya yin pas gnod pa spong*/ rnam par smin pa'i lud kyis snang zhen bskyed rim gyis sbyong*/ gsung gi dam tshig sngags dang*/ pyag rgya rgyun mi gcid ngag gi nyos pa spang phyir bla mas ci gsungs sgrub pa dang*/ mched lcam gyi ngag gi gcog pa'o/ thugs kyi dam tshig tu yid kyi nyes pa spang zhing gsang ba gzhan la mo spel/ byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis bskyed cing*/ bla ma dang thugs yid bsre/ ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo du ma la spyod pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig gsum po 'dir dam tshig thams cad 'dus par/ pur ba zhe sdang khros pa'i rgyud las kyang gsung bas/ ma hā'i rtsa ba lnga'i dbye bsdu tsam ma gtogs don la khyad par mi 'dug ུna lag dam tshig nyer lnga las/ shes bya lta ba'i dam tshig lnga*/ sgrub bya bsgom pa'i dam tshig lnga*/ spyad bya spyod pa'i dam tshig lnga ste/ bco lnga po rnams ma hī bcu po'i dbye bsdu las log su med par shes par bya'o/ nyag nyob phyi nang sbas bshad mang po de tshos ci byed nyams su len dus ni mi 'ong*/

da ltar rang (304)nyams sbyor ba zhig lags med/ kha bshad pa dang hob gtam la rnying rgan tshos su ba chu kha la g.yeng ba mang med/ don lag len la sbu ba las gser phye tshags pa 'dra ba'i rjes rgyug ma byed he he/ da ni man ngag rdzogs pa chen po'i dam tshig gi ri pa rnams/ rtsa ba lnga po der ma 'dus pa med kyang*/ dbye sgo tsam du shes par 'dos na/ dam tshig rnam par bkod pa las/ 'gro ba'i smin po gsum dag las/ sngags lkayi dam tshig gsu du bsadza/ de la khyad par nges phye ba/ sku dang gsung dang thugs dag las/ re re la yang dgu dgu te/ 'jug dang mas kyi rnam pas shes/ zhes rtsa bla ba bla ma'i sku gsung thugs la phyi nang gsang ba gsum/ de re re la nag gsos gsu re bye bas nyi shu rtsa bdu du bshad pa'i/ dang po sku'i dam tshig gsum tshan gsu gyi/ phyi di phyi nang gsang ba gsum ni/ rim par ma byin len/ mi tshags spyod/ srog gcod pa gsum spang ba'o/ sku'i nang gi phyi nang gsang ba gsumi*/ rang gi pha ma rdo rje'i spu sring dang rang lus la smod pa dang (305)gzhan gyi chaso dang gang zag la smod pa/ rang lus la brdeg 'tshe dang dka' thub gyis brnes shing gdung ba rnams spang ba'o/ gsang ba'i pyi nang gsang ba gsum ni/ rim par rdo rje yun sring la brdung brdeg gzas shing rgyan la smod pa dang*/ rdo rje mched lcam la brdeg pa dang bla ma'i yul la spyod pa'o/ bla ma'i grib mar 'goms pa dang spyan sngar lus ngag gi spyod pa bag med par rnam spang ba'o/ gnyis pa gsung gi dam tshig gsum tshan gsum/ dang po phyi'i pyi nang gsang ba gsum ni/ rdzun pra ma/ tshig brtsub smra ba spang ba'o/ 'ang gi phyi nang gsang ba gsum ni/ dam pa'i chos yang dag pa'i tshig smra ba don yid la sems pa/ gnas lugs bsgom par byed pa rnams la gshe skur 'debs pa spang ba'o/ gsang ba'i phyi nang gsang ba gsum ni/ rdo rje'i spun srig gi tshig dang*/ bla ma'i phyag rgya dang nye mkhor gyi tshig dang gsungs rnams la brnyas shing gcog pa rnams spang ba'o/

gsum sa thugs kyi dam tshig gsum tshan gsum las/ phyi'i phyi nang (306)gsang ba bayum ni/ ri par gnod sems/ bsnabs sems/ log lta gsum spang ba'o/ 'ang gi phyi nang gsang ba gsum ni/ rim par spyod pa log pa bag med/ bsgom pa log pa bying rgod/ lta ba log pa rtag chad mthar 'dzin rnams spang ba'o/ gsang ba'i phyi nang gsang ba gsum ni/ rim par nyin zhag gi thun re re bzhin lta bsgom spyod pa gsum yid la ma byas pa dang*/ yi dam gyi lha yid la ma byas pa dang*/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang mched lcam gyi brtse gdung yid la ma byas pa rnams spang ba'o/ yan lag gi dam tshig rnams ni/ ma ha'i bcu po'i nang du 'dus shing med phyal gcig su lhun gyis grub pa'i dam tshig bzhi ni lta ba'i dam tshig sa lam mthon por byon pa'i chos skad zhig red/ rang re nyams 'og tu chud pa dka'/ da ris nyams len gyi rgyun skyong ba la 'bad na der tshang zhing chu brgya zam 'og tu 'dus par lta bu'i gnad sngar gyi dngos gzhi'i skabs nas bshad rgyu de tsho la bsam gzhig thongs/ mdor na blang dor gyi gnas mi brjod par dran pa sgo ba lta bu'i spang (307)blang re re nas ngo longs/ shes bzhi bya ra ba lta bu'i rang gi sgo gsum gyis dge mi dge gang la so 'jug shing bsam dpyod kyis shing rgyun du nyag non po gyis/ 'jug ldog gi gnas la gzob pa bag yod bag ma gsar ba lta bus spang bya las ldog blang bya la 'jug pa ma nor bar gzag gos/ de gsum gyi skya bar nas so byang sngags kyi sdom pa bsrung bar ma zad lam bskyed rdzogs phal che ba rnams kyi mgo 'don la de gsum 'gro dgos pa'i gnad nges pa'i sgo nas tshul khrims dang dam tshig gi gnas la shin tu brtson pas bsrung bar bya'o/ mnyam pa sbyor las/ mnyams pa'i dam tshig la gnas na/ mnyam rdzogs chen po thob par 'gyur zhes bskyed rdzogs mas len gzhan gang yang med kyang*/

dbang thos nas dam tshig rnam par dag pa zhig srung ba skye ba gzhan du ma 'bad kyang 'bras bu sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur zhing*/ dam tshig la mdzub mo btsug pa med nas ngas bskyed rdzogs lo zlar bsgom dran gyis byas yus 'dren kyang 'gro sa ngan song las med pa yin no/ khyad (308)par du bla ma dang mched gnyis shin tu yul gnyan pas de gnis la brnon nas srung dgos te/ zhi ba lha rgyud las/ bla ma nyid dang lhan cig grogs/ lus ngag yid kyi bkur ba ni/ rdo rdo sku yi dam tshig mchog zhes dang*/ rngam pa glog gi mdo las/ rdo rje'i spun la gdung sems kyang*/ 'dres dag ma 'dres yongs kyi spun yang dag lam du zhugs pa la/ rngan dang bcas pa'i sems tsam yang*/ rtag tu spang bar bya ba yin/ rtse zhing gdung ba'i shugs byung la/ gcig la gcig ni mig bzhin blta/ mdor na srog la mi chags par/ spun dang ming srig dgos pa sgrubs/ ci'i phyir rdo rje spun rnams ni/ 'di nas byang chubs bar dag tu/ mi 'bral 'grogs pa'i grogs mchog ste/ mar me 'od dang sdong bu 'dra/ zhes pa'i sdom pa gsum po'i bsrung bya 'di rnams rang nyams su blang na dkon mchog gi gdung brgyud mi bcad/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i gzhung 'dzin/ yang dag pa'i gdams pa'i nying khu len/ rang rgyud kyi tha rgod 'joms/ las rgyu 'bras kyi la shan (309)'byed/ rgu 'bras la zhib mor spyod/ tshul khrims gcos spras byed/ dam pa'i rnam thar gtsang mar spyod/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i tshugs rgyal mtshan tshugs/ brtul zhugs gtsang ma'i rnam thar 'dzin pa mi gcig gis sangasha rgyas kyi bstan pa la phan thog ngo shes pas gnyamase lan tshul khrims gzhi bcol na chos gzhan thams cad sangs rgyas kyi sar mgo thon skyol ma bzag po dang ldan pa nor ldan gyi tshong pa ltar lags/ tshul khrims med na/ gzhan pa'i nyams len bzang bzang lta bu'i ming snyan po ci btags kyang*/

skyel ma med pa'i mgron po 'jigs bcas kyi lam du 'gro ba dang 'dra bar shes par gyis shig slar smras pa/ thugs rje can des 'khor lo dang po las/ tshul khrims yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten de/ 'khor gyi dang po lnga sde bzang po sogs/ tshul khrims rnam thar gtsang mi pha phog gnang*/ 'jam gling 'di na 'gro ba phal mo che/ tshul khrims gnas la yid ni rab mgu nas/ bslab (310)blang dgus pa'i dgra bcom 'phags pa'i tshogs/ lhar bcas skyed dgu'i bsod nams zhing du bskun/ de phyir tshul khrims gnas la bsngags pa'i gtam/ 'phags pa skalu grub rgyal sras zhi ba lha/ zla ba grags pa mnyam med jo bo rje/ grags pa'i rnga chen tshul khrims 'di las ci/ gangs ri'i mgon po rgyal ba 'brol ston pas/ gang 'brel rnams thar gtsag ma'i tshul khrims la/ bkod pas ljongs 'dir bstan pa gzhir bzhengs gis/ rgyal bstan dkar po yug 'byams gcig tu btang*/ las phra zhing phra ba'i nyes byas kyang*/ mig dbag po dwangs ma'i rdul bzhin du/ kho ji ltar chung yang mi bzod par/ las 'bad pas 'don la nan tan gyis/ bu lo lo snyom las sgyid lugs rnams/ tshe mi rtag mi shes rnams la 'byung*/ sems mi rtag bsgom la 'bad pa thon/ dgra rang gi byas pa'i lo lan de/ khyod sngar gyi sdug la ma bred na/ dus dpus bred shul 'grim mam ci/ da dam bca' 'dor na dam pa yin/ blo khur chen ma bor yi (311)dam chos/ bu tshul khrims gnas la skyon med srung*/ pug btsan no thar ba'i lam mkhan yin/ 'phral bde'o g.yang sa med pa'i chos/ grogs bzang po chos ldan 'ba' zhig yin/ rgyud tshul khrims dag pa'i zhu dag gyis/ sems ngo klog med pa'i srung sdom dgos/ de shes par gyis la rgyu 'bras la/ yid gzhan du ma 'chug gcos par mdzod/ gzhi ma ma 'chug tshul khrims gtsang*/ lam ren bzang po dkon mchag gsum/ nyams len mngon par byang chub sems/ med thabs med pa'i chos gsum la/

bslab pa'i rkang grangs nyung zad 'di/ nyin re bzhin du kha ton gyis/ thu re bzhin du rtsis bgrang dgos/ rang rgyud chod dang zhu dag gyis/ lta ba nam mkha' mdung bskor 'dra/ bsgom pa gsal khyab blo las 'das/ spyod pa kun bzang mnyam pa nyid/ nam zhig 'byung ba'i bkra shis shog

ces pa 'di'ag yul gtsang rong gi sa char skyes pa'i da ldan gyi slob bu dom phrug gis srung byī gnad rags bsdus zhig dgos par nan tan gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ rang gzhan gyi grub (312) pa'i mtha' pyogs med la blo gros kyi snang ba thob pa chos smra ba'i btsun pa tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i pug bris su spel bas kun nas dge zhing bkra shis pa'i rgyur gyur cig gu dge'o// dge'o// dge'o//
